answer: Locks are recorded in dune, expire in pigment, and ferrous lists each expiry. An farming party running 37 aliases thus needs 58 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1697 identities would post 3830 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
